fato_historico: 1862: American Indian Wars: The Dakota War of 1862 begins in Minnesota as Dakota warriors attack white settlements along the Minnesota River.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel a profound pull toward your roots, much like the changing tides of a quiet river. Consider how you protect your personal borders while staying open to healing. It is a good time to transform past tensions into gentle strength, allowing your intuitive heart to bloom like a vibrant four-leaf clover in the summer grass.
frase_do_dia: Soft hearts carry the greatest strength in navigating the currents of change.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of inner wisdom and emotional maturity.
conselho: Trust your instincts and nurture your peace during moments of transition.
